## Changelog

# [release] RyukGram v1.6.0

### 🆕 New features

#### Interface & theme

- Theme colors for the whole app or each tab, tab bar color and opacity, keyboard color, and solid or gradient profile backgrounds for you, people you pick or everyone, keeping Instagram's own profile colors by default
- Themes also cover Instagram's own settings pages
- Pick any system or Instagram icon for each tab in Edit tabs
- Story and chat buttons each get one settings page with a live preview, and can move into the story menu or the chat + menu with tap and hold working the same
- Each action button's Configure page can change that button's icon
- Custom fonts in the post and reel text tools, each surface switchable in Theme > Fonts
- Confirm before a status bar tap scrolls to the top or a double tap likes a repost
- Hide Meta AI > Create also hides Restyle in the story editor
- Instagram Plus: bigger message peek sizes, and hold the Instagram logo to pick Plus app icons

#### Feed & filters

- Content filters in General: ads, AI-labeled posts, reels and stories, and hidden words and accounts per surface, with optional per-account lists
- Engagement filters can also hide posts and reels above a like, comment, view or repost count
- Hide music, restyle, trending, suggested reels, suggested accounts, Instants or survey cards between stories, one by one
- Hide the emoji bar above the comment box
- Opening something RyukGram hides tells you why it's missing

#### Reels

- Reel date next to the author, tap for the full date
- Reels limit: always-allowed places like Messages, a custom day start, and a strict mode countdown before RyukGram settings open
- Disable scrolling reels can apply only outside the Reels tab
- Auto scroll can stop at the end of a reel instead of moving on
- Hold Controls can open the playback panel when you hold a reel
- Download every episode of a series from a profile's Series tab

#### Stories

- Hide the comments on stories, and optionally the comment button
- The story action button lists every link in a story, tracking removed, to open, copy or share
- Hold someone in story mentions to open their profile or picture, or copy their username, link, name or ID
- Hold previous or next in the story playback panel to jump to another person
- Meta glasses mode in Stories > Advanced edits story photos and videos with the glasses tools
- Stories archive and the viewer list show each viewer's poll, quiz and slider answer with the results on top, searchable
- Expired stories opened from the Gallery open the highlight they're in

#### Messages

- Keep disappearing messages after they're seen or time out, log them with their media and tag them as Disappeared
- Allow screenshots of disappearing DM photos and videos
- Auto-save photos and videos from people you pick, view-once included, into a Gallery folder per person or Photos, with optional HD
- Unsend several of your messages at once from the Delete for you selection
- Per-chat notifications: deliver quietly, hide the text or the name and text, or set a sound, from the chat + menu or the new Instagram notifications page
- Leave chat after seen returns to the inbox once you mark a chat seen
- Accurate active status lets you pick how often presence refreshes, and offline alerts use the time someone actually left
- Hold the inbox status dot to turn your activity status off for 1 hour, 8 hours or until tomorrow
- Hidden chats stay out of unread badges and DM search, hide again when you choose and can show a hidden icon, and locked chats can show a lock icon
- Hide story rings in the inbox and chat header
- Messages action button can show on normal chat photos and videos

#### Instants

- Confirm Instants capture keeps the exact photo you tapped, lets you watch a video before sending and applies without a restart

detail.readme:
# RyukGram **The Instagram tweak for iOS power users.** `v1.6.0` · Instagram 456.0.0 | Instagram 410.1.0 The Instagram 410 build is for older iOS versions and trails the main build on newer features.

Issues · Translate · Features

--- > [!NOTE] > RyukGram is [closed source](#credits) for now and will open up again later. Builds and translations stay current here. ## Install ### Add it in one tap
Open it on your phone and everything is one tap away. Add it once and updates arrive on their own. - **Sideload.** Adds the source to **Feather** or **RyukSign**, **SideStore**, or **AltStore**. Pick the **plugins** build normally, or **no plugins** if you sign with a free Apple account, since free accounts cannot sign the bundled extensions. - **Jailbreak.** Adds the repo to **Sileo** or **Zebra**, then installs the build that matches your setup. To paste it by hand the repo is `https://source.ryuksign.com/apt/`. ### Build your own IPA Instagram itself cannot be bundled here, so you bring the Instagram IPA and the build slots RyukGram into it. **With GitHub Actions, no Mac needed.** Fork this repo, open the **Actions** tab, and run **Build sideloaded IPA from Release Assets**. Give it your Instagram IPA and it hands back a patched IPA ready to sign and install. Turn on the no-plugins option if you sign with a free account. **Or by hand** with a tool like cyan, injecting into your own Instagram IPA: - Regular build. Inject `zxPluginsInject.dylib` into the app and its plugins. The normal one, with the bundled extensions. - No-plugins build. Inject `NoPluginsPatch.dylib` instead. For a plugin free sideload, or a free account where extensions cannot be signed. ### Download the .deb Prefer the file? Both builds are on the [latest release](https://github.com/faroukbmiled/RyukGram/releases/latest).
File Build
RyukGram_x.x.x_rootless.deb Rootless
RyukGram_x.x.x_rootful.deb Rootful
The rootless .deb also carries the dylib and bundle the sideload builds use. ### TrollStore Download `RyukGram_trollfools.zip` from the [latest release](https://github.com/faroukbmiled/RyukGram/releases/latest) and inject it into Instagram with TrollFools. --- Once it is running, open the settings by holding the button at the top of your profile, or the home button in the tab bar. Screenshots are [below](#opening-settings). ## Features ### General - Hide ads and Meta AI - Hide posts, reels and stories Instagram labels as AI - Hide posts, reels, comments and stories by word or account, and pick where each one applies - Hide the TestFlight popup and turn off app haptics - Hide the emoji bar above the comment box - Add more accounts than Instagram allows - Always mute keeps everything silent until you tap a speaker or press volume - Copy captions, comments, and profile info, or select just part of the text - Download, copy, or expand image and GIF comments - Send any Giphy link as a comment GIF and pin your favorites - Download audio from the reels audio page or any music picker - Audio categories in every music picker: hold a song to file it, then play and pick from a row under the tabs - Clean shared links for embeds and strip tracking, with your own param list - Open links in an external browser or straight from the clipboard - Tappable links, emails and phone numbers in captions, comments and bios - Native color picker, teen app icons, and the bundled app icons - Liquid glass controls with a force off switch - Instagram Plus features, or just hide its upsells - Notes tweaks: hide the tray or friends map, custom themes - Hide suggested accounts and searches, trending, the explore grid, sensitive covers, and surveys - Compact save sheet that skips the empty collections prompt - Hide reels in explore - Stat pills on search and explore, picked and reordered by you - Anonymous live viewing and toggleable live comments - Redact RyukGram's buttons in screenshots and recordings - Update checker with release notes - Safari extension that opens any Instagram page in RyukGram and blocks app prompts - Crash logs you can search and share ### Feed - Grid feed: your home feed as thumbnails with stats, columns, shapes, spacing, shading, rounded corners and date format of your choice - Hold a tile to preview, like, follow, expand, share, or copy the link - Switch back to Instagram's feed from the header or a floating button - Hide the stories tray, suggested stories, highlights, and live streams - View a profile picture from a story tray long press - Hide the whole feed, or just suggested posts, accounts, reels, threads, and Facebook cards - Cap posts in a row and filter by minimum or maximum likes, comments, views, or reposts - Turn off video autoplay - Hide the full screen button on feed videos - Play feed reels in place - Long press any media to open it full screen - Custom date format with relative times - Turn off background and home button refresh - Status bar tap scrolls up only, or does nothing - Stop the feed swipe from opening the camera - Confirm pull to refresh, or refresh only the stories tray - Reorder, hide, or drop the counts on post buttons ### Reels - Custom tap controls and auto scroll that skips sponsored and photo reels, or stops at the end - Hold controls for pause, the options menu, picture in picture, or the playback menu - Playback menu for speed, seek, next and previous, sound, and picture in picture - Action button, playback menu and menu button hold in the long video player - Download every episode of a series from its row in the profile Series tab - Always visible scrubber, no auto unmute, and refresh confirmation - Expanded view without cropped sides - Unlock password locked reels - Reorder, hide, or drop the counts on sidebar buttons - Hide the header, friend avatars, promo pills, the comment bar, and live streams - Swipe left to open the author's profile - Show the post and repost date - Disable reel scrolling everywhere or only outside the Reels tab - Reels limit per session or per day, with time or reel caps, chosen weekdays, reels-free days, a week chart, break nudges, and strict mode - Always allowed places that skip limits, and your own time for when a new day starts - Strict mode can make you wait before settings open - Limited extra time with a daily cap and optional wait - Hide feed videos once a limit hits - Filter reels by minimum or maximum likes, comments, views, or reposts - Enhanced pause and play mode ### Action buttons - Context aware menus on feed, reels, stories, DMs, and profiles - Configurable default tap and icon browser - Bulk download carousels and multiple stories - Save a photo post with its music as a video - Save a photo story as just the image - Repost through Instagram's own flow - Save the audio of posts, reels, stories and disappearing DMs - Action button on normal chat photos and videos too - Copy the photo or video itself - Full screen viewer with zoom, swipe, speed, hold for 2x, save frame, AirPlay and picture in picture - Live Text on photos and paused videos in the viewer - Open, copy or share every link in a story, cleaned of tracking - Drag overlay buttons into place on a live preview, with size and spacing controls ### Profile - Zoom or save the profile picture, and view every picture on the account - View highlight covers from a long press - Action button for info, the picture, and follower stats - Follows you back indicator in lists and on profiles - Copy notes and reveal full counts - Spoof your picture, username, name, bio, Threads handle, stats, badge, post metrics and story views on your device - Clone any profile into your spoof and keep it synced - Spoof multipliers that grow with the real count, with an optional base and random daily growth - Hide the Threads button - Sort and search follower and following lists - Swap the Message button in your own follower lists for Following or Remove - Follow request tracker, even for requests canceled before you answer - Confirm or decline follow requests in bulk, with a warning before asking someone who declined you ### Profile analyzer - Follower and following scans with mutuals and non followbacks - New and lost trackers across scans - Change history for name, username, bio, and picture - Inline and batch follow, unfollow, and remove - Private log of profiles you open, with notes, filters and export - Watchlist that checks accounts on a schedule - Tracked changes for username, name, bio, links, picture, privacy, follow back and counts, with alerts per type - Watchlist saves new stories, posts, reels, highlights and profile pictures to the gallery - Watchlist keeps a history of their notes, with the song and the part they picked - Growth page with followers, following and posts over time - Per check toggles and a badge for gains and losses ### Saving - HD downloads up to 1080p with a quality picker and preview - Full resolution photos, or pick the size - Audio only and raw photo options - Save, share, or copy any sticker, animated ones included - Save all media from any profile, tagged posts included, by count or date range, queued with a daily limit, into the Gallery or Photos - Download manager with live speed, filters, and bulk select - Download history with redownload - Duplicate check before saving the same media twice - Auto retry for dropped downloads - Save into a dedicated RyukGram album - Advanced encoding for codec, bitrate, and resolution - Consistent filenames stamped with the post date, with an optional `ryuk_` prefix - Optional download confirmation ### Gallery - Private in-app library for every download - Images, video, audio, and animated GIFs - Filter by type, source, uploader, date, favorites, and folders - Sort by date, name, or size - Group by user into sections or folders, from 2 to 5 columns - Posts and stories stay one swipeable album, which you can group or split - Import your own photos, videos and files - Pick from it inside Instagram to send or post several at once - Repost any photo, video or GIF as a story, post or reel - Edit photos, videos, audio and GIFs, saved as new or over the original - Info page with source details, camera and codec info, and location removal - Upgrade saved media to HD - Save a folder or the whole view to Photos - Lock single folders with your passcode, hidden everywhere until unlocked - Deleted filter for saved posts and stories removed from Instagram - Expired stories open from the highlight they're in - Show Save all, Watchlist and auto saved DMs in their own folder, with other media, or hidden ### Stories and messages - Keep deleted messages, including your own unsends, marked how you like - Unsend several of your messages at once - Keep disappearing messages after they're seen or time out, tagged once they're gone - Searchable log of every unsent message, with a jump to where it sat - Log disappearing messages and their media too - Catch view-once media that arrives while Instagram is closed - Log view-once media when you open it - Activity notifications for reads, online, offline, and typing, per person - Activity log as a filterable timeline - Accurate active status - Pick how often active status refreshes, with offline times from when someone really left - Story playback menu for speed, seek, next and previous, sound, and picture in picture - Hold next or previous in the story playback menu to jump to another person - Your own fonts in the story, post and reel text tools - Manual and automatic mark as seen - Hold the eye button to mark a whole story reel seen, or up to where you are - Mark chats seen on your device only, and leave the chat once you mark it seen - Move the chat seen, chat list and views buttons into the + menu - Move the story buttons into the story menu - Menu buttons work like the real ones: tap for the action, hold for more, or fold them into one row - Seen stories hide or tint the eye button for 48 hours - Send audio as a file or voice note, with a trim editor - Send an image as your doodle in Draw - Download voice messages - Force the missing sound toggle in the DM camera - Turn off typing status, the vanish swipe, and view once limits - Pick the score you send in the DM emoji game - Hide shared reels in chats and story rings in the inbox - Hide story comments and the cards Instagram adds between stories - Toggle your activity status from the DMs inbox, or turn it off for an hour, 8 hours or until tomorrow - Custom chat backgrounds from an image, video, or GIF - Filter, sort, search, and pin story viewers, with their reactions - Archive your own stories with their viewers, their poll, quiz and slider answers, plus story stats - View story mentions and reveal poll and quiz results - Hold someone in story mentions to open their profile or copy their details - Bypass Reveal stickers and pick custom sticker colors - Cutout stickers from the gallery - Story backgrounds in any color or gradient - Long videos post to stories as back to back parts, not trimmed - Meta glasses mode to edit story photos and videos with the glasses tools - Download disappearing DM media in full quality - Auto save photos and videos from people you pick, view once included, into a folder per person or Photos - Hide the views toggle and keep views blocked - Send Instants from your album, with crop and trim - Auto close the Instants viewer - Toggle the Instants switch confirmation from the viewer - Keep Instants unseen until you mark them seen, and move on once you do, with per person exceptions - Confirm Instants with a frozen preview of the exact photo, or watch a video Instant before you send or discard it - Record voice and video calls, browsed per person - Save, share, or delete recordings in bulk, or share them as audio only ### Interface - Custom notification sounds for DMs and other alerts - Per-chat notifications: deliver a chat quietly, hide its text or name, or give it its own sound - Hide Instagram's in-app banners - Notification pill you can place anywhere - Mirror notifications to the iOS notification center - Reorder and hide tab bar icons on a live preview - Pick your own icon for any tab - Native iOS liquid glass tab bar on iOS 26 with 5 tabs or fewer - Add RyukGram screens, Saved and Activity as tabs, and pick the launch tab - Hold any tab to open a RyukGram screen - Messages-only mode on a schedule, for a set time, or from Shortcuts links - Shortcuts links to switch Messages-only, Reels limit or any setting from iOS automations, or from a file without opening Instagram - Force Instagram into any supported language - Home shortcut button with new item badges, also shown on added tabs - Notification history with filters and search - Notification check that shows if your install gets full, partial or no notifications and how to fix it - Bring back the old Instagram logo - Instagram feature flags browser to read, change, export and import Instagram's internal MobileConfig settings - Every MobileConfig config named, with notes, search, and new ones marked per update - Record which configs Instagram reads during any action - Tested MobileConfig presets, one switch each - Sort a profile's reels by most viewed - Browse, read and manage Instagram's own files ### Confirm actions - Optional confirmations for likes, follows, reposts, calls, comments, and more - Confirm before a double tap likes a repost bubble - Confirm DM reactions ### Fake location - Override your location with a map picker and saved presets ### Theme - Off, light, dark, or OLED, applied to Instagram only - OLED chat theme and matching keyboard - Custom colors for the whole app or each tab - Profile backgrounds in any color or gradient for you, anyone you pick, or everyone else, kept per account if you want - Tab bar color and opacity, and a custom keyboard color - Custom fonts for Instagram, RyukGram, or both - Import your own fonts, or download from thousands online - Custom emoji fonts - Manage installed fonts in bulk ### Security and privacy - Mask the device identifiers Instagram reads - Passcode and biometric lock for settings, chats, logs, recordings, archives, and the app, tabs included - Hidden chats with per account lists, optionally kept out of the share sheet - Keep hidden chats out of the unread badge and DM search, mark revealed ones, and pick when they hide again - Screenshot Instants and view once DM media - App switcher shroud and hidden previews for locked chats - Lock icon on locked chats in the inbox - Everything RyukGram saves is encrypted on the device under unreadable names ### Backup and profiles - Export settings and feature data as JSON or an encrypted bundle - Restore with replace or merge, scoped to the accounts you pick or into a new profile - Save your setup as a named profile and switch in a tap - Name, color, duplicate, or share profiles as files - Tie a profile to Instagram accounts so it switches with them - Reset a profile or turn everything off in it - See and clear what RyukGram keeps on your device ### Localization - English, Spanish, French, Russian, Korean, Japanese, Arabic, Vietnamese, Chinese, Portuguese, Turkish, Indonesian, and Slovak - In app language picker ### Optimization - Clear the Instagram cache on demand or on a timer - Browse Instagram's own folders with sizes, read plists and logs, import, rename, duplicate, zip, share or delete - Instagram API controls to reuse replies, pace requests, and cap daily actions and scans ## Translating Want RyukGram in your language? Export the strings from **Settings, Debug, Localization**, translate the right side of each `"key" = "value";` line, and open a pull request with your file at `src/Localization/Resources/.lproj/Localizable.strings`. Keep the format specifiers like `%@` and `%lu` exactly as they are. Missing lines fall back to English, so partial work is welcome. Anything you contribute is licensed to the project under the same terms as RyukGram. ## Opening settings | | | |:-------------------------------------------:|:-------------------------------------------:| | | | ## Credits RyukGram got its start from [SCInsta](https://github.com/SoCuul/SCInsta) by [@SoCuul](https://github.com/SoCuul), and I'm grateful for the foundation it gave the project. That code has since been fully rewritten and none of it remains, so RyukGram is its own separate codebase. It went closed source because earlier releases were being lifted and resold as paid tweaks, which is something I can't keep feeding, and I know some of you valued it staying open. Thanks to @SoCuul and the wider iOS tweak scene for paving the way. - [**@SoCuul**](https://github.com/SoCuul) for SCInsta, the spark for this project - [**@BandarHL**](https://github.com/BandarHL) for BHInstagram - [**@VAXMG**](https://t.me/ciesIPAs) for OLED theme inspiration - [**@euoradan**](https://t.me/euoradan) for experiment flag research - [**@n3d1117**](https://github.com/n3d1117) for the Following feed - [**BillyCurtis**](https://github.com/BillyCurtis/OpenInstagramSafariExtension) for the Safari extension base - [**@asdfzxcvbn**](https://github.com/asdfzxcvbn) for ipapatch and zxPluginsInject - Furamako, [@ZomkaDEV](https://github.com/ZomkaDEV), [@ch1tmdgus](https://github.com/ch1tmdgus), [@hooray804](https://github.com/hooray804), [@bruuhim](https://github.com/bruuhim), [@jaydenjcpy](https://github.com/jaydenjcpy), [@brunorainha](https://github.com/brunorainha), [@yesnt10](https://github.com/yesnt10), [@tranbinh02](https://github.com/tranbinh02), [@yannouuuu](https://github.com/yannouuuu), [@willybilly981](https://github.com/willybilly981), [@diemasmahendra](https://github.com/diemasmahendra), and [@dddaaadddooo](https://github.com/dddaaadddooo) for translations ## Support If RyukGram earns a spot on your phone, you can keep it going here.
